titolo: Allanite
descrizione: This threat actor targets business and industrial control networks in the power-utility sector, for the purpose of espionage. In 2017, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security warned U.S. critical infrastructure operators about this threat actor and its capabilities.

titolo: Trisis
descrizione: This threat actor targets the Triconex safety instrumented system (SIS) controllers produced by Schneider Electric, as well as a proprietary network communications protocol. SIS controllers maintain safe conditions in an industrial system should other failures occur. In 2017, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security released a malware analysis report on the tools used by this […]

titolo: Compromises of government embassies, telecommunications companies, and a Russian oil company
paesi_vittima: Pakistan, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Turkey
descrizione: A group has attacked 131 victims in thirty organizations since September 2018, including unidentified government embassies, telecommunications firms, and a Russian oil and gas company.

titolo: Targeting of sporting and anti-doping organizations ahead of 2020 Tokyo Olympics
descrizione: Just prior to news reports suggesting that the World Anti-Doping Agency might ban Russian athletes from all international sporting events, APT 28 attacked a number of sporting and anti-doping organizations.

titolo: APT 28
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Armenia, Belgium, Canada, China, France, Georgia, Germany, Hungary, Japan, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, Pakistan, Poland, Tajikistan, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor is linked to espionage campaigns, high-profile doxing efforts, and disruptive incidents that compromised targets believed to be of interest to the Russian government.

titolo: Targeting of Russian aerospace and defense conglomerate
descrizione: Hackers targeted the Russian state-owned aerospace and defense conglomerate Rostec with a DDoS attack on its website. The website was taken down briefly before being returned to service. Rostec blamed the incident on Ukrainian “radicals” who are likely part of the IT Army.

titolo: Targeting of Teamviewer, a German-based company that makes widely used remote-access tools for companies
descrizione: Teamviewer, a German-based company that makes widely used remote-access tools for companies, detected an irregularity within their internal IT environment. The company was able to quickly trace the intrusion to APT 29, although it was unclear if any of Teamviewer’s customers had been compromised as part of the breach.

titolo: Targeting of TVP, a public service broadcaster in Poland
descrizione: The Polish deputy minister of digital affairs accused Russia of launching a distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attack on Polish public broadcaster Telewizja Polska (TVP) to prevent Polish citizens from watching a match between Poland and the Netherlands during the Euro 2024 soccer tournament.
UAC-0188 is a Russian threat actor that has been previously observed deploying malware on U.S. and European financial and insurance institutions.

titolo: FlyingYeti
descrizione: FlyingYeti is a threat actor known primarily for targeting Ukrainian military entities but has also targeted Ukrainian citizens with phishing lures that capitalize on anxiety over potential housing loss.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian citizens who were concerned about facing loss of housing in Ukraine
descrizione: Cloudfare’s security team identified a phishing campaign using Cloudflare Workers (a Cloudfare product) and GitHub. FlyingYeti distributed files that ostensibly helped users adapt to the end of a Ukrainian moratorium on evictions and termination of utility services, but which really installed malware on the target system.

titolo: Targeting of Polish government institutions
descrizione: Poland’s computer emergency response team detected a phishing campaign targeting senior government officials. It was unclear whether the attacks had immediate aims beyond gaining and maintaining access to government networks.

titolo: Targeting of Czech and German political entities, state institutions, critical infrastructure, and German companies in the logistics, armaments, aerospace, and IT sectors
descrizione: APT 28 targeted unspecified Czech government institutions, the headquarters of the Social Democratic Party of Germany, and German companies in the aerospace, armaments, IT, and logistics sectors by exploiting a critical vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook.

titolo: Targeting of AlphV ransomware group
descrizione: The FBI broke into the networks of the AlphV ransomware group and some of its affiliates. It used that access to steal decryption keys from the group and distribute them to over five hundred affected organizations over eighteen months. In December 2023, the FBI seized the group’s leak site and severely curtailed its operations.

titolo: Targeting of organizations using JetBrains software
descrizione: The Dukes, a threat actor associated with the Russian SVR intelligence agency, were detected using a previously undetected vulnerability in TeamCity, a product used to test and exchange software code before releasing it, to gain access to organizations’ networks. The attacks appear to have been opportunistic, as the Dukes targeted any vulnerable network, rather than […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian telecommunications operator Kyivstar
descrizione: Kyivstar, a mobile-phone network that serves over twenty-four million people in Ukraine, was hit by a cyberattack that knocked its entire network offline. Solntsepek, a hacktivist group associated with the Russian threat actor Sandworm, claimed responsibility for the attack.

titolo: Targeting of academic institutions, think tanks, and other research groups
descrizione: Calisto was observed targeting a variety of academic institutions, think tanks, and research organizations. The attacks were aimed at stealing credentials for a U.S.-based grants management portal. The report on Calisto’s targeting came the same day that three of its members were sanctioned by the UK government.

titolo: Targeting of Polish government organizations with Follina vulnerability
descrizione: In 2022, APT 28 distributed malicious files claiming to provide an update on potential nuclear terrorism, which utilized the Follina vulnerability in the Microsoft support tool to break into the victim’s system. Ukraine’s cybersecurity agency reported on a similar campaign in 2022.

titolo: Targeting of Polish government organizations with PlugX malware
descrizione: In 2022, Mustang Panda impersonated officials from different EU countries to distribute PlugX malware on Polish government systems.

titolo: Targeting of Polish government agencies using compromised Ukrainian email accounts
descrizione: Nodaria distributed a compromised spreadsheet reporting on the humanitarian crisis in Ukraine to Polish government agencies in July 2022.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian power grid
descrizione: In October 2022, Sandworm deployed a new variant of CaddyWiper on the industrial control systems of a Ukrainian power plant. The attack caused power outages across Ukraine and occurred on the same day as missile strikes on power infrastructure.

titolo: Targeting of French think tanks, government agencies, universities, and businesses
descrizione: The National Cybersecurity Agency of France (ANSSI) said it had found APT 28 had established a presence on various networks in France since at least 2021 and was leveraging that access to steal emails and information about the compromised systems.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian telecommunications providers
descrizione: Russian threat actor Sandworm attacked the networks of at least eleven telecommunications providers in Ukraine, which led to disruptions in service for some customers.

titolo: Targeting of foreign embassies in Kyiv
descrizione: The Dukes were observed sending phishing emails to various foreign embassies in Kyiv, Ukraine, after the start of Ukraine’s counteroffensive in June 2023. The campaign appears aimed at gathering intelligence on foreign sentiment toward Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian energy facility
descrizione: APT 28, a Russian threat actor, broke into a Ukrainian energy facility’s networks of after sending spear-phishing emails to workers at the plant.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian armed forces planning operations system with Infamous Chisel
descrizione: Sandworm targeted Ukrainian military officials with a piece of Android malware dubbed Infamous Chisel. The campaign’s goal appeared to be to steal Ukrainian military plans.

titolo: Targeting of Russian missile design firm
descrizione: APT 37, a North Korean threat actor, compromised sensitive networks, including an email server, at the Russian missile design firm NPO Mashinostroyeniya. The company has previously been involved in designing hypersonic missiles and newer generation ballistic missiles.

titolo: Targeting of diplomatic agencies in Eastern Europe
descrizione: Russian threat actor the Dukes targeted embassies and diplomatic agencies in Eastern Europe with a variety of spear-phishing lures. The attacks used a new variety of malware based on an older piece of malware the Dukes had used previously.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian defense forces with Capibar and Kazuar spyware
descrizione: Turla targeted elements of the Ukrainian military with Kazuar, a backdoor, and Capibar, a piece of malware used to compromise Microsoft Exchange servers.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government agencies in phishing attack
descrizione: GhostWriter launched phishing attacks against Ukrainian government agencies. The group used malicious documents purporting to be a report from an expert at the National Defense University of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian email servers
descrizione: APT 28, a Russian threat actor, used spear-phishing lures to gain a hold on Ukrainian government and military email servers and then attempted to expand access to the broader email network. The campaign has been active since at least November 2021.

titolo: Targeting of Russian iPhone users
descrizione: In June, cybersecurity company Kaspersky announced that it was targeted by an advanced threat actor that compromised several Apple iOS devices in the company using zero-click exploits sent in text messages. Follow-up reporting indicates the threat actor used at least four zero-day exploits in the attack and exploited a previously unknown hardware flaw in Apple […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian civil-society groups
descrizione: APT 28 targeted Ukrainian civil-society groups using a combination of phishing techniques and compromised Ubiquiti Wi-Fi routers. The phishing emails impersonated documents from a Ukrainian defense think tank, the Center for Defense Strategies.

titolo: Targeting of government networks with Snake malware
descrizione: The FBI said it had disrupted a malware network, Snake, run by Turla, a unit within Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB). Snake had been operational for almost twenty years and had been placed on computers in over fifty countries, including the United States and Russia. The U.S. operation disabled Turla’s Snake malware using a tool […]

titolo: Targeting of the Ukrainian public sector
descrizione: The Russian threat group Sandworm was observed destroying data on Ukrainian state networks using a malicious script, RoarBat. Sandworm gained initial access to the networks by compromising VPN accounts that lacked two-factor authentication.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government bodies
descrizione: Russian group APT 28 aimed a spear-phishing campaign at Ukrainian government organizations, advertising fake Windows Update guides in order to collect intelligence on government activities.

titolo: Targeting of European government agencies and diplomats
descrizione: Russian threat actor the Dukes ran a phishing campaign posing as various European embassies and sending fake Google Calendar invites that redirected those who clicked on the invite to malicious documents. The operation’s goal appears to be to steal documents related to the Ukraine war.

titolo: Targeting of European diplomatic entities
descrizione: Russian threat group the Dukes ran a spear-phishing campaign against diplomatic entities and systems that were transmitting sensitive information about regional politics, aiding Ukrainian citizens fleeing the country, and helping the government of Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government websites using two-year-old backdoors
descrizione: Ukraine’s Computer Emergency Response Team said that Russian state hackers, Nodaria, breached multiple government websites using backdoors placed as far back as December 2021. The hackers used the backdoors to modify content on the affected websites, although what content was modified is unclear.

titolo: Targeting of Scottish National Party member of Parliament (MP)
descrizione: Russia-backed threat actor Calisto is believed to be behind a spear-phishing attack on the email accounts of Stewart McDonald, a Scottish National Party MP, and a member of his staff. McDonald said he worried the Russian government planned to leak the emails it stole, although as of March 28, 2023, none have been made public.

titolo: Nodaria
descrizione: Nodaria is a Russia-linked threat actor. It has been active since March 2021 and is primarily linked to attacks against Ukraine, including the January 2022 WhisperGate wiper attacks. The group likely also targeted organizations in Georgia and Kyrgyzstan.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government authorities
descrizione: Gamaredon, a Russian threat actor group, targeted Ukrainian government authorities. The group used spear-phishing emails to gain initial access and deployed surveillance malware on affected systems.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian national news agency, Ukrinform
descrizione: The Russian threat group Sandworm used a new Golang-based data wiper, SwiftSlicer, to violate the integrity and accessibility of information within the network of Ukrainian news agency Ukrinform.

titolo: Targeting of Hive ransomware group
descrizione: The U.S. Department of Justice ran a months-long disruption campaign against the Hive ransomware group. During this time, the FBI infiltrated the group’s servers and stole decryption keys, which they distributed to victims, preventing $130 million in ransom payouts.

titolo: Calisto
descrizione: Calisto is a Russian government-affiliated threat actor. The group uses spear-phishing tactics to compromise individual email accounts for espionage purposes. The group has also been known to leak stolen emails as part of information-warfare efforts.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations with old cybercrime malware
descrizione: A Russian threat actor, Turla, used defunct command and control website domains to reactivate dormant backdoors installed before 2013 by criminal hackers. Turla then downloaded new information-stealing malware on the infected networks to identify whether they would be valuable for espionage.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. satellite network
descrizione: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency said Russian cyber operatives had infiltrated the network of a U.S. satellite communications provider. How far the intrusion extended or what kind of information the Russians could have stolen remains unclear.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. National Laboratories
descrizione: In July 2022, Calisto targeted scientists at the Brookhaven National Laboratory with a fake login page to steal credentials. The hackers appear to have used the harvested credentials to access documents related to counter-proliferation and nuclear accountability in Russia and other states.

titolo: Targeting of organizations supporting Ukraine
descrizione: As part of a phishing campaign, Calisto targeted NATO-affiliated military and strategic research institutes, a Ukraine-based defense contractor, and former intelligence officials and Russia experts who were working at nongovernmental organizations.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian local government organization
descrizione: Sandworm targeted Ukrainian local government networks in November 2022 with Caddywiper malware, which wipes most data on a system while preserving domain controllers. Researchers speculate this function allows Sandworm to maintain access inside networks after deploying Caddywiper.

titolo: Targeting of Polish and Ukrainian transportation companies
descrizione: Russian threat actor Sandworm targeted transportation and logistics organizations in Ukraine and Poland with Prestige ransomware starting in October 2022.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian networks via fake telecommunications firms
descrizione: A Russian threat actor masqueraded as a Ukrainian telecommunications firm in order to gain access to other networks in Ukraine, both through spear-phishing and malicious public domains.

titolo: Space Pirates
descrizione: Researchers identified a Chinese cyber-espionage group that has exchanged tools with Winnti Umbrella, APT 27, and Mustang Panda. The group has been observed using repurposed, publicly available malware in espionage campaigns throughout Asia since at least early 2022. The group could also be moonlighting as criminal hackers, as they have been observed attacking Chinese companies […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government agencies in espionage campaign
descrizione: Gamaredon, a Russian threat actor, was found using newly developed malware to steal information from Ukrainian government agencies. The malware was distributed through a phishing campaign.

titolo: Targeting of Montenegrin government infrastructure
descrizione: Montenegro accused the Russian government of launching a widespread cyberattack against computer systems. The attack lasted several days and severely harmed several vital industries, including electricity and water systems, transportation networks, and online portals for state services. The U.S. embassy issued a warning to travelers in the country that immigration systems run by the Montenegrin […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government agencies
descrizione: The Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine found that Gamaredon had been breaking into Ukrainian government email accounts.

titolo: Targeting of industrial enterprises and public institutions in Central Asia and Eastern Europe
descrizione: Chinese hackers used phishing emails to plant PortDoor malware on the systems of industrial organizations in Afghanistan, Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine. Security researchers detected the hackers exfiltrating data to a server with a Chinese IP address.

titolo: Targeting of the Ukrainian Azov Regiment
descrizione: Turla distributed Android-related malware disguised as an app that contributes to distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks against Russian websites. However, the application did not conduct DDoS attacks and instead provided Turla access to infected systems.

titolo: Targeting of high-profile individuals at European embassies
descrizione: The Dukes sent out phishing emails to targets at European embassies to gain access to sensitive information.

titolo: Targeting of St. Petersburg Economic Forum
descrizione: The Ukrainian IT Army attacked the systems of the St. Petersburg Economic Forum in advance of Russian leader Vladimir Putin’s speech, delaying it for over an hour.

titolo: Targeting of media stations such as newspapers and radio stations in Ukraine
descrizione: The Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) warned that Sandworm was exploiting the newly discovered Follina vulnerability in Microsoft Office to attack media organizations in the country.

titolo: Targeting of Rostec
descrizione: A Chinese threat actor targeted two research institutes run by Rostec, a major Russian state-owned defense conglomerate. The attackers used spear-phishing lures to plant malware and steal data on Russian radar and electronic warfare capabilities.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations in phishing campaign
descrizione: APT 28 sent phishing emails masquerading as the Computer Emergency Response Team of Ukraine (CERT-UA) with the subject line “Cyberattack.” The email included a malware-laced attachment enabling APT 28 to gather and steal data.

titolo: Targeting of Russian and Belarusian websites
descrizione: Ukraine’s IT Army compromised Docker Engine honeypots in an attempt to execute distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks against Russian and Belarusian websites.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian users of Chrome, Edge, and Firefox browsers
descrizione: Russian threat actor APT 28 targeted Ukrainian internet users with a new malware variant. The malware was sent to targets via email attachments titled “ua_report.zip.” When executed, the malware enables hackers to steal and exfiltrate cookies and saved passwords from Chrome, Edge, and Firefox browsers.

titolo: Targeting of a defense and cybersecurity organization in the Baltics
descrizione: Russian threat actor Turla targeted defense and cybersecurity organizations in the Baltic states. Turla sent emails to targets, each with unique links that led victims to download a malicious file.

titolo: Targeting of diplomatic organizations in the Americas, Asia, and Europe
descrizione: Russian threat actor APT 29 targeted diplomatic entities with spear- phishing emails disguised as embassy administrative notices, which were sent from compromised email addresses of other diplomatic entities. The campaign used services such as Trello, Firebase, and Dropbox for command and control. Once the hackers infiltrated the target system, they established long-term access and collected […]

titolo: Targeting of Russian military officials
descrizione: Chinese threat actor Mustang Panda targeted Russian government computer systems with PlugX malware. The malware was disguised in a malicious file masquerading as a PDF, which was named after a Russian border guard unit.

titolo: Targeting of government network in Vinnytsia, Ukraine
descrizione: APT 28 conducted phishing campaigns targeting the Ukrainian military and government employees. Strontium succeeded in compromising a government network in Vinnytsia, a city in western Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of major Ukrainian broadcasting company
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted a major broadcasting company with the DesertBlade wiper. This incident followed the Russian military’s announcement that it would destroy Ukrainian disinformation targets.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian agricultural firm
descrizione: Sandworm targeted a Ukrainian agricultural firm’s network by placing a file encryptor on its network, leaving it vulnerable to future destruction. Assessments indicate Sandworm intended to disrupt grain production and exports.

titolo: Targeting of a Ukrainian transportation and logistics provider
descrizione: Sandworm targeted the network of a Ukrainian transportation and logistics provider with a destructive attack. The provider is based in western Ukraine, which is also where foreign military and humanitarian assistance enters the country, suggesting an intent to disrupt the movement of Ukrainian supplies to conflict hotspots.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian power stations
descrizione: Russian-linked Sandworm hackers targeted high-voltage electrical substations in Ukraine. The attackers used a novel variant of Industroyer malware, dubbed Industroyer2, which interacts with control systems that manage the flow of power. The hackers also deployed multiple strains of wiper malware as part of the attack.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian institutions and U.S. and European foreign policy institutions and think tanks
paesi_vittima: France, Germany, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Russian threat actor APT 28 targeted Ukrainian media organizations, government institutions, and foreign policy think tanks in the United States and the European Union with attempts to establish access to victims’ systems, gain tactical information related to the invasion, and exfiltrate other sensitive information. Microsoft assumed control of seven of APT 28’s internet domains used […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon targeted Ukrainian organizations in a phishing campaign. The hackers sent malicious emails with lures related to the Russia-Ukraine conflict, including attachments labeled “Information on war criminals of the Russian Federation” and “Necessary_military_assistance.” The emails contained malware that allowed Russian operators to conduct espionage.

titolo: Targeting of government agencies in the European Union
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon targeted Ukrainian organizations in a phishing campaign. The hackers sent malicious emails with lures related to the Russia-Ukraine conflict, including attachments labeled “Information on war criminals of the Russian Federation” and “Necessary_military_assistance.” The emails contained malware which allowed Russian operators to conduct espionage.

titolo: Targeting of Hungary’s foreign ministry networks
descrizione: Hackers from the Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) and military intelligence agency, GRU, conducted a lengthy espionage campaign targeting Hungary’s foreign ministry networks. The initial infection was delivered via attachments in phishing emails and spread through the internal network, compromising more than 150 sites of more than 90 Hungarian foreign missions.

titolo: Targeting of Hungarian Foreign Ministry networks
descrizione: The Federal Security Service and the Russian military intelligence agency have conducted cyberattacks against the Hungarian Foreign Ministry since at least 2012 to retrieve critical information Hungary’s diplomatic relations with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and the European Union (EU).

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian telecommunication company’s internet service
descrizione: Russian hackers targeted Ukrainian telecommunication company Ukrtelecom’s internet service, forcing users offline. Whether the malicious activity was a DDoS attack or a more sophisticated intrusion remains unclear. Service was restored fifteen hours after the initial compromise.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian state bodies
descrizione: Russian APT InvisiMole, which has ties to Gamaredon, conducted a phishing campaign targeting Ukrainian organizations with the LoadEdge backdoor. The backdoor allowed Gamaredon to install surveillance software and other malware onto infected systems.

titolo: Targeting of Asus routers
paesi_vittima: Canada, India, Russian Federation, United States
descrizione: Sandworm targeted WatchGuard and ASUS routers with Cyclops Blink malware, an advanced modular botnet. The malware gives Sandworm access to data and files stored on compromised networks. The malware affects devices that do not belong to critical organizations, suggesting that its purpose may be to build infrastructure for later attacks on high-value targets.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations with CaddyWiper
descrizione: Sandworm targeted Ukrainian organizations with CaddyWiper malware, destroying user data hosted on several dozen systems. Evidence suggests Sandworm infiltrated the targets’ networks before installing the wiper.

titolo: Targeting of Viasat’s satellite broadband service
descrizione: The Russian military intelligence agency, known as GRU, targeted the internet provider Viasat’s satellite modems with a wiper that caused widespread communication outages throughout Ukraine on February 24, the same day Russian forces invaded the country.  The attack caused a loss in military communications at the start of the war and affected other government services. The […]

titolo: Targeting of Moscow Stock Exchange and Sberbank websites
descrizione: Hackers from Ukraine’s IT Army targeted the websites of the Moscow Stock Exchange and Russian lender Sberbank with a DDoS attack. The incident was planned and conducted through posts on Telegram channels and other social media directing thousands of members to attack specified targets.

titolo: Ukrainian IT Army
descrizione: The Ukrainian IT Army is a threat actor comprised of international and Ukrainian volunteer hackers working in collaboration with officials from Ukraine’s defense ministry to target Russian infrastructure and websites. The IT Army is organized through a Telegram channel where new Russian targets are listed for volunteers to attack.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian and Polish military personnel
descrizione: Belarusian threat actor UNC1151 targeted the private email addresses of Ukrainian soldiers in a phishing attack. UNC1151 hacked the email accounts of military personnel and then leveraged the compromised address books to send further malicious emails, many of which were sent to Polish military personnel.

titolo: Targeting of Latvian, Lithuanian, and Ukrainian computer systems
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted computer systems in Latvia, Lithuania, and Ukraine with a wiper dubbed HermeticWiper. The malware was aimed at Windows devices, corrupting systems’ master boot records, displaying signs of ransomware as a decoy, and destroying stored data. This followed another wiper attack aimed at Ukraine in January.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government websites
descrizione: Hackers for the Russian military intelligence agency, known as GRU, targeted the websites of the Ukrainian parliament, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Council of Ministers, and the Security Service of Ukraine with a DDoS attack that took the sites offline for two hours. A destructive wiper attack impacting hundreds of machines in Ukraine was reported simultaneously.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian, Latvian, and Lithuanian computer systems
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted computer systems in Ukraine, Latvia, and Lithuania with a HermeticWiper malware attack. The malware was aimed at Windows devices, corrupting systems’ master boot records, displaying signs of ransomware as a decoy, and destroying stored data.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian banks and defense ministry
descrizione: Russia targeted the Ukrainian defense ministry website and multiple banks with a DDoS attack, taking their sites offline and halting ATM service in some cases. Ukraine, the United States, and the United Kingdom attributed the attack to Russia, which denied the accusations.

titolo: Targeting of American defense contractors
descrizione: For at least two years spanning from January 2020 through February 2022, Russian state-sponsored threat actors targeted American cleared defense contractors (CDCs) to acquire and exfiltrate sensitive data and export-controlled technology. These CDCs were contracted by the Department of Defense (DoD) and the U.S. Intelligence Community in areas including command and control, intelligence, surveillance, and […]

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian organizations and Western government entity
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon used spear-phishing emails and malware to target Ukrainian emergency response, security, and aid distribution organizations. In addition, Gamaredon presumably targeted a Western government entity in Ukraine.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government and information technology (IT) sector systems with WhisperGate malware
descrizione: The Russian Army’s Main Intelligence Directorate (the GRU) used WhisperGate wiper malware on Ukrainian systems on January 13, 2022. The wiper masqueraded as ransomware, offering victims the chance to decrypt their data for a fee, while in reality, the malware wiped the system. The wiper was found on systems throughout Ukraine, including the foreign ministry […]

titolo: Targeting of Russian diplomats in Asia
descrizione: The North Korean threat actor Konni launched a spear-phishing campaign against Russian diplomats in Indonesia. Konni spoofed the email address of the Russian embassy in Serbia to send a fake celebratory email that downloaded a remote access trojan once opened.

titolo: Targeting of French public organizations
descrizione: Nobelium, a Russian threat actor, is believed to have compromised the servers of several French organizations as early as February 2021 to launch spear-phishing attacks against foreign organizations.

titolo: Targeting of REvil
descrizione: The FBI, U.S. Cyber Command, and allied governments took down the Tor servers of the ransomware gang REvil.

titolo: Targeting of various industries through Gmail compromises
descrizione: APT28 was detected conducting a wide-ranging phishing attack against more than fourteen thousand Gmail users who work as activists, journalists, and national security officials.

titolo: Targeting of major aerospace companies in the United States, Russia, Europe, and the Middle East
descrizione: An Iranian-linked threat actor dubbed MalKamak used a remote access Trojan (RAT) known as ShellClient to target aerospace and telecommunication companies. The RAT employed had been in development since at least 2018 and piggybacked off of Dropbox servers.

titolo: Calypso
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Brazil, Indonesia, Russian Federation, Thailand, Turkey
descrizione: Calypso has been observed targeting government agencies worldwide since 2016, including institutions in Brazil, Indonesia, Russia, Thailand, and Turkey. The group was also implicated in a breach of Afghan telecommunication company Roshan.

titolo: Targeting of Slovakian government agencies
descrizione: Nobelium launched spear-phishing attacks against Slovakian diplomats by posing as the Slovak National Security Authority.

titolo: Targeting of the United States, Belarus, Canada, Mongolia, and Russia in an espionage operation
paesi_vittima: Belarus, Canada, Mongolia, Russian Federation, United States
descrizione: APT 31 was detected using a new remote access Trojan horse in more than ten attacks throughout the first half of 2021 to target governmental groups in Russia and several other countries.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian naval exercises
descrizione: Russian hackers were accused of defacing the Ukrainian Navy’s website and uploading fake documents to spread disinformation about the annual Sea Breeze military exercises.

titolo: Targeting of Republican National Committee
descrizione: Cozy Bear, a group of Russian-sponsored hackers, were accused of breaking into the U.S. Republican National Committee’s computer systems. How much access the group obtained or what information they were able to remove is unknown

titolo: Targeting of Dutch police in the investigation of flight MH17 shootdown
descrizione: The Dutch police units investigating the destruction of Malaysia Airlines Flight 17 over Ukraine in 2014 were hacked sometime in 2017 by groups associated with the Russian intelligence services.

titolo: Targeting of Russian government agencies
descrizione: Chinese-linked hacking group TA428 is believed to be responsible for a series of attacks on the Russian government in late 2020. The goal of the attackers was to penetrate officials’ emails and classified networks and steal information.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian agencies in Russian spear-phishing campaign
descrizione: Russian hackers targeted Ukrainian officials in a series of spear-phishing attacks to gain access to government servers for espionage purposes.

titolo: Targeting of cloud computing servers in brute force attacks
descrizione: Russian hackers targeted various enterprise and cloud computing companies across the world with brute force attacks in attempts to gain access.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. Agency for International Development
descrizione: The Russian hacking group Nobelium compromised the company hosting the servers for the U.S. Agency for International Development (USAID) and used its access to send phishing emails to other aid groups.

titolo: Targeting of Russian submarine designer
descrizione: Chinese-linked hackers targeted the general director of a Russian nuclear submarine design company with a spear-phishing email designed to share a malicious link.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian elected officials by Russian-sponsored hackers
descrizione: From January 2021 to at least March 2021, Gamaredon, a group associated with Russian intelligence agencies, sent malicious documents to several high-ranking Ukranian officials. The objectives of this spear-phishing campaign are still unclear.

titolo: Targeting of classified government data in Ukraine
descrizione: Unnamed Russian threat actors attempted a large-scale cyber operation to obtain classified government data. However, Ukrainian authorities prevented a breach.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government document management system
descrizione: Russian threat actor Gamaredon targeted users of the Ukrainian government’s document management system, the System of Electronic Interaction of Executive Bodies (SEIEB), with malware-encrypted documents.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian web servers
descrizione: Russian threat actors targeted vulnerable web servers of multiple Ukrainian security and defense organizations with a virus that added them to a botnet used to carry out distributed denial of service attacks.

titolo: Targeting of French IT monitoring company
descrizione: Russian APT Sandworm used two different malware strains to hack the IT monitoring software of French cybersecurity firm Centreon. The hacking campaign lasted from 2017 to 2020 and only affected entities using the open-source version of Centreon’s software.

titolo: Targeting of Malwarebytes’ Office 365 tenant
descrizione: The same threat actor that compromised SolarWinds abused applications with privileged access to Microsoft 365 and Azure environments, granting the actor access to a limited subset of Malwarebytes’ internal emails.

titolo: Targeting of SolarWinds customers
descrizione: The Russian APT group Cozy Bear inserted malware into a service that pushes software updates for SolarWinds’ Orion platform, which is used across countless U.S. government agencies and Fortune 500 firms. FireEye was the first to reveal that it had fallen victim to the intrusion and later presented evidence that the Orion platform was compromised […]

titolo: Targeting of unnamed European foreign ministry
descrizione: The Russian threat actor Turla used specialized malware called Crutch to exfiltrate documents belonging to an unidentified European foreign ministry.

titolo: Targeting of pharmaceutical companies and vaccine researchers with password spraying
descrizione: Russian hackers used password spraying in attempts to access accounts belonging to individuals involved in vaccine development.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. government networks
descrizione: Russian hackers used publicly known networking gear vulnerabilities to steal data from U.S. state, local, territorial, and aviation computer networks. The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and the FBI reported that the stolen information included network configurations and vendor lists and that the hackers potentially had access to election information.

titolo: Targeting of Russian aerospace and defense companies
descrizione: North Korean hackers used spear-phishing emails and social media messages in hopes of stealing credentials related to Russian aerospace and defense companies.

titolo: Targeting of Tokyo Olympics organizers, logistics services, and sponsors
descrizione: The Russian threat group Sandworm targeted Tokyo Olympics organizers, logistics services, and sponsors through cyber reconnaissance operations.

titolo: Targeting of the Norwegian parliament’s email system
descrizione: Russian hackers compromised email accounts of Norwegian politicians and parliament employees. The intrusion occurred months after Norway warned that “Russia shows increased willingness and ability to use a wide range of instruments to achieve its political goals.”

titolo: Targeting of TrickBot computer networks
descrizione: U.S. hackers targeted the Russian botnet Trickbot, known for spreading the Ryuk ransomware, in preparation for the 2020 U.S. presidential election.

titolo: Targeting of entities in India, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Malaysia, Russia, and Ukraine
paesi_vittima: India, Kazakhstan, Malaysia, Russian Federation, Ukraine
descrizione: Chinese hackers distributed SlothfulMedia malware, which modifies files and logs keystrokes. Specific targets have yet to be disclosed.

titolo: Penetration of unnamed U.S. federal agency
descrizione: Russian hackers used compromised credentials to install malware and ultimately steal files from unnamed U.S. government agency computers.

titolo: Targeting of Azerbaijani government networks
descrizione: Responsible for disguising Zebrocy malware, which creates a persistent backdoor, as North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) training materials. Azerbaijan, which cooperates with NATO, is a suspected target.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. political campaigns, advocacy groups, and political consultancies
descrizione: Russian hackers attempted to steal log-in credentials primarily belonging to more than two hundred political campaigns, advocacy groups, parties, and consultants.

titolo: U.S. Cyber Command
descrizione: Responsible for orchestrating and executing various operations to protect the United States and its interests, including steps to disrupt the Internet Research Agency and the Trickbot botnet.

titolo: Targeting of United Kingdom trade minister’s email account
descrizione: Hackers accessed the account of former United Kingdom (UK) Trade Minister Liam Fox, between July 12 and October 21 2019, stealing six tranches of documents detailing British trade negotiations with the United States. Hackers then released the documents as part of a Russian disinformation campaign targeting the 2019 UK general election.

titolo: Ghostwriter
descrizione: Believed to be responsible for conducting a hacking and information operations campaign in Eastern Europe. Hackers compromised websites and email accounts and used them to publish fabricated documents pushing anti–North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) narratives. They then donned fake personas of local officials to promote the fabricated documents on social media.

titolo: Targeting of websites in Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland
descrizione: Hackers targeted websites and email accounts in Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland to publish fabricated documents pushing anti–North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) narratives consistent with Kremlin talking points.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government organizations
descrizione: Hackers sent spear-phishing emails to the accounts of officials in various Ukrainian government organizations. The emails contained attachments that downloaded malware when opened.

titolo: Targeting of email servers using Exim mail transfer agent
descrizione: Hackers from Sandworm exploited a zero-day vulnerability in Exim mail transfer agent software, which runs on email servers around the world, granting them the ability to remotely execute commands on the compromised servers.

titolo: Targeting of ministries of foreign affairs and a national parliament in Central Asia and Eastern Europe
descrizione: Hackers used a remote access trojan (RAT), ComRAT v4, to exfiltrate sensitive documents from Central Asian and Eastern European government computers.

titolo: Targeting of German critical infrastructure owners
descrizione: Hackers used supply chain vulnerabilities to access German critical infrastructure companies’ information technology (IT) systems.

titolo: Targeting of Poland’s War Studies University
descrizione: Hackers breached Poland’s War Studies University’s website and posted a fake letter from the university’s commander, urging Polish soldiers “to fight against the American occupation.”

titolo: Global phishing campaign against industrial, government, and civil society targets
descrizione: The Russian threat actor APT 28 used phishing campaigns to steal credentials from organizations across the world, in government, private sector, and civil society. They also searched the internet for vulnerable webmail servers.

titolo: Targeting of Ukraine with coronavirus phishing emails
descrizione: The Russian hackers Hades (aka APT 28) targeted Ukraine with coronavirus-themed phishing emails. At the same time, viral disinformation about the virus spread in Ukraine, causing riots.

titolo: Watering-hole attacks targeting Armenian government websites
descrizione: The Russian threat actor Turla compromised four Armenian websites, two belonging to the government and two closely related, to use in a strategic web compromise/watering-hole attack.

titolo: Targeting of Japan, Russia, and South Korean entities
descrizione: The Chinese government–aligned APT Tonto Team used Bisonal malware for over ten years in various campaigns against entities in Japan, Russia, and South Korea.

titolo: Tonto Team
descrizione: Chinese government-aligned APT that used Bisonal malware for over ten years in various campaigns against entities in Japan, Russia, and South Korea.

titolo: Attack on Austrian foreign ministry
descrizione: The suspected Russian hackers conducted a weeks-long attack on Austria’s foreign ministry.

titolo: Intensified attacks against Ukrainian national security targets
descrizione: The Russia-aligned threat actor Gamaredon intensified its efforts to compromise Ukrainian defense and intelligence targets. The attacks include both cyberespionage and attempted sabotage of physical assets.

titolo: Targeting of Burisma
descrizione: The alleged Russian actors hacked Burisma, a Ukrainian gas company whose board Joe Biden’s son sat on. President Trump had previously pressed Ukraine to open an investigation into Biden and Burisma, which led to his impeachment.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian government entities
descrizione: Gamaredon, a Russian-speaking APT, targeted Ukrainian government entities from September to November 2019.

titolo: DarkUniverse
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Belarus, Ethiopia, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Russian Federation, Sudan, Syrian Arab Republic, Tanzania, United Republic of, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: DarkUniverse was a threat group affiliated with Russia that was active for at least eight years, from 2009 until 2017.

titolo: Large-scale attacks against Georgia
descrizione: Russian group Sandworm carried out large-scale cyberattacks against targets in Georgia.

titolo: Hijacking of Iranian hacking infrastructure
descrizione: The Russian threat actor Turla took over an Iranian espionage operation belonging to Iranian-linked APT 34 (aka Oilrig) and used it to attack a number of targets while masquerading as Iran.

titolo: Targeting of European ministries
descrizione: Believed to have gone dark, Russian threat actor the Dukes targeted the ministries of foreign affairs of three European countries and a European Union (EU) country embassy in the United States with malware.

titolo: Targeting of Czech Foreign Ministry
descrizione: A threat actor launched a persistent campaign against the Foreign Ministry of the Czech Republic that lasted several months. This campaign follows previous attacks on the Czech Foreign Ministry in 2018 and 2017.

titolo: Targeting of embassies and foreign ministries in Eastern Europe and Central Asia
descrizione: A threat actor targeted embassies and foreign ministries in Eastern Europe and Central Asia with a phishing campaign that deployed a form of Zebrocy malware on computers, creating backdoors.

titolo: Targeting of Internet of Things (IoT) devices used by Microsoft customers
descrizione: The threat actor exploited office devices’ weak, outdated security to access the networks of several Microsoft customers and infiltrate accounts with more privileges.

titolo: Targeting of investigative journalists at Bellingcat
descrizione: A threat actor conducted a phishing attack on investigative journalists at Bellingcat who have been probing Russian intelligence activities.

titolo: Compromise of Yandex
sponsor_stato: Australia, Canada, New Zealand, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor deployed Regin, a rare type of malware, in an attempt to spy on user accounts for Yandex, a Russian search engine and email provider.

titolo: 2019 Indonesian elections
descrizione: Senior Indonesian election officials accused Chinese and Russian hackers of manipulating and modifying Indonesia’s voter data base to disrupt the presidential elections.

titolo: Whitefly
descrizione: This threat actor has been active since mid-2017, targeting mainly health-care, media, telecommunications, and engineering organizations in Singapore, in addition to multinational companies with a presence in the country. The group has also targeted defense, telecommunications, and energy companies in Russia, the United Kingdom, and Southeast Asia. The group relies on a combination of custom […]

titolo: U.S. Cyber Command offensive attack of Russian troll farm
descrizione: In November 2018, the U.S. Cyber Command launched an offensive campaign to combat a Russian troll operation known for using disinformation tactics.

titolo: Targeting of Internet Research Agency
descrizione: U.S. Cyber Command conducted operations to disable online activities of the Internet Research Agency (IRA), a Russia-based company closely affiliated to the Russian government that conducts information operations. The operation was meant to prevent the IRA from interfering in the 2018 U.S. midterm elections.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. and European think tanks
descrizione: Hackers set up fake login pages or sent spoof e-mails to people who work with the think tanks in an attempt to trick them into handing over information, such as passwords.

titolo: Attempted attack on the Democratic National Convention (DNC) during 2018 elections
descrizione: The DNC alleged it was targeted in an unsuccessful cyberattack eight days after the 2018 elections in an attempted spear-phishing campaign.

titolo: Attempt to compromise Ukraine’s judicial system
descrizione: Ukraine’s security agency thwarted an attack attempting to target the country’s court system.

titolo: Targeting of emails of German lawmakers, military officials, and embassy staff
descrizione: German security officials detected a cyberattack, believed to be by the Russian group Snake, on the email accounts of German celebrities, lawmakers, military officials, and staff of several German embassies.

titolo: Compromise of Ukrainian government
descrizione: A Russian actor tied to Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) targeted Ukrainian government agencies with a backdoor attacker called Pterodo before and during Russia’s seizure of Ukrainian vessels.

titolo: Targeting of the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons
descrizione: A threat actor, believed to be Russian military intelligence, targeted the office of the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons in The Hague with a view of compromising its Wi-Fi network for espionage purposes. Dutch authorities were able to foil the operation, and in a joint press conference with UK officials publicly identified four […]

titolo: Compromise of the U.S. Anti-Doping Agency
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the U.S. Anti-Doping Agency. Seven of the individuals alleged to be behind this incident, believed to be Russian military intelligence (known as GRU), were indicted by the U.S. Justice Department.

titolo: Compromise of the Court of Arbitration for Sport
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the Court of Arbitration for Sport. Seven of the individuals alleged to be behind this incident, believed to be Russian military intelligence (known as GRU), were indicted by the U.S. Justice Department.

titolo: Compromise of the Canadian Centre for Ethics in Sport
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the Canadian Centre for Ethics in Sport. Seven of the individuals alleged to be behind this incident, believed to be Russian military intelligence (known as GRU), were indicted by the U.S. Justice Department. Canada issued a statement attributing the incident to Russian military intelligence.

titolo: Compromise of FIFA
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the Federation Internationale de Football Association (FIFA). Seven of the individuals alleged to be behind this incident, believed to be Russian military intelligence (known as GRU), were indicted by the U.S. Justice Department.

titolo: Targeting of Westinghouse Electric Corporation
descrizione: A threat actor targeted Westinghouse Electric Company, a nuclear power developer, for espionage purposes. One of the individuals alleged to be behind this incident, believed to be Russian military intelligence (known as GRU), was indicted by the U.S. Justice Department.

titolo: Global bank attacks
paesi_vittima: Bangladesh, Brazil, Chile, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, Russian Federation, Taiwan, The Philippines, Turkey, United States, Uruguay, Vietnam
descrizione: A North Korean group is believed to have stolen hundreds of millions of dollars by infiltrating the computer systems of banks around the world since 2014.

titolo: Gorgon Group
paesi_vittima: Russian Federation, Spain, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Also known as Aggah. This threat actor targets government entities in the United States and Europe. It also conducts criminal operations.

titolo: Targeting of the office of U.S. Senator Claire McCaskill
descrizione: The office of U.S. Senator Claire McCaskill (D-MO) announced that it was targeted by Russian state-sponsored cyber actors, following a report of the incident in the Daily Beast.

titolo: Compromise of U.S. electric utility control rooms
descrizione: A threat actor compromised air-gapped, or isolated, networks owned by U.S. electric utility companies by penetrating the networks of trusted vendors.

titolo: Targeting of congressional campaigns for the 2018 U.S. midterm elections
descrizione: A threat actor targets the campaigns of candidates running for Congress in the 2018 U.S. midterm elections.

titolo: Targeting of chemical research and media organizations in Germany
descrizione: A threat actor targets German media companies and organizations involved in chemical weapons research, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Targeting of a chemical plant in Ukraine
descrizione: A threat actor used a tool called VPNFilter to target a chemical plant in eastern Ukraine that provides chlorine to water- and sewage-treatment plants in that country. Ukraine’s intelligence service claims to have thwarted the incident.

titolo: Targeting of financial and chemical organizations in Europe
paesi_vittima: France, Germany, Netherlands, Russian Federation, Switzerland, Ukraine
descrizione: A threat actor uses a tool, called Olympics Destroyer, to target financial organizations in Russia and biological and chemical laboratories in Ukraine and other countries in Europe.

titolo: Targeting of German critical infrastructure sectors
descrizione: A threat actor targeted critical infrastructure entities in the energy, water, and telecommunications sectors, prompting the German government to issue a public alert. In remarks following the alert’s release, the head of Germany’s domestic intelligence agency accused Russia of controlling the targeting campaign.

titolo: Targeting of South Korean actors prior to meeting of Donald J. Trump and Kim Jong-un
descrizione: Two separate threat actors targeted South Korean government organizations prior to the meeting between U.S. President Donald J. Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Alleged Russian compromise of networking equipment
descrizione: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the UK National Cyber Security Centre issued a joint alert warning of a Russian state-sponsored campaign to compromise networking equipment, such as routers and switches, to support their cyber operations. A few weeks later, the FBI took control of a botnet with over five hundred thousand compromised devices […]

titolo: Operation Parliament
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Canada, Chile, Denmark, Djibouti, Egypt, Germany, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Iraq, Israel, Jordan, Korea (Republic of), Kuwait, Lebanon, Morocco, Oman, Palestine, State of, Qatar, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Serbia, Somalia, Syrian Arab Republic, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: This threat actor uses spear-phishing techniques to target parliaments, government ministries, academics, and media organizations, primarily in the Middle East, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of the German Foreign Office
descrizione: A threat actor has compromised the German Foreign Office, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Targeting of a European defense agency
descrizione: A threat actor targeted a European defense agency with a spear-phishing email, which only deploys a payload if the victim opens an email attachment and scrolls to page 3.

titolo: Targeting of U.S. energy and other critical infrastructure sectors
descrizione: A threat actor that the U.S. government believes to be sponsored by the Russian government, targets entities in the U.S. energy, nuclear power, water, aviation, and critical manufacturing sectors. According to the Department of Homeland Security, this activity has been ongoing since at least 2014.

titolo: Compromise of an air-gapped German government network
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the Informationsverbund Berlin-Bonn, a computer network air gapped from the global internet, used by the German chancellery, parliament, Foreign Office, and other government departments based in Bonn, Germany.

titolo: Targeting of foreign ministries
descrizione: A threat actor targeted a foreign ministry in Europe and in North America using spear-phishing techniques for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of computer networks associated with the 2018 Pyeongchang Winter Olympics
descrizione: A threat actor, using a tool called Olympic Destroyer, successfully disrupted computer networks associated with the 2018 Winter Olympics in Pyeongchang, South Korea, before the opening ceremony. Among other things, the incident crashed the Wi-Fi network in the Olympic stadium and the press center.

titolo: Iron Tiger
paesi_vittima: Australia, Canada, China, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Japan, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation, Taiwan, Thailand, United States
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments as well as technology, education, and telecommunications companies primarily in Asia and the United States, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of the Dukes
descrizione: A threat actor successfully compromised the networks of the Dukes, gaining visibility into the Dukes’ targeting methods and operations. This compromise allegedly helped the U.S. intelligence community to attribute the 2016 compromise of the Democratic National Committee and other entities to Russian state-sponsored actors.

titolo: Targeting of international sports federations
descrizione: A threat actor targeted international sports organizations in Western Europe in the run-up to the International Olympic Committee’s banning Russian athletes from participating in the 2018 Winter Olympics in South Korea.

titolo: Targeting of consulates and embassies in Eastern Europe
descrizione: A threat actor targeted consulates and embassies in Eastern Europe for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Targeting of the citizen journalism website Bellingcat
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise Bellingcat, a citizen journalism website that conducts investigations, including about Russian involvement in the Syrian and Ukrainian conflicts.

titolo: Bad Rabbit
paesi_vittima: Bulgaria, Japan, Russian Federation, Turkey, Ukraine
descrizione: Using a tool called Bad Rabbit, a threat actor launched a ransomware operation that encrypted data on networks in Bulgaria, Japan, Russia, Turkey, and Ukraine. The operation is believed to have disrupted the Kiev metro system’s payment network and delayed flights at Odessa’s airport. In October 2018, the United Kingdom attributed this incident to Russian […]

titolo: Tick
paesi_vittima: China, Japan, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation
descrizione: Japan announced a formal link between the threat actor Tick and Chinese intelligence, saying that it was responsible for a series of attacks in Japan. Tick has been active since at least 2008 and has primarily targeted Japan and South Korea. This threat actor targets organizations in the finance, defense, aerospace, technology, health-care, and automotive […]

titolo: Compromise of Kaspersky Labs
descrizione: A threat actor, believed to be the Israeli government, compromised Kaspersky Labs, a Russia-based cybersecurity company. The compromise of Kaspersky allegedly led Israeli intelligence to tip off U.S. officials that a former contractor had classified data from the National Security Agency on his home computer.

titolo: Targeting of a Swiss federal agency
descrizione: A threat actor targeted servers controlled by the Swiss Federal Department of Defense, Civil Protection, and Sports.

titolo: WhiteBear
paesi_vittima: Korea (Republic of), United Kingdom, United States, Uzbekistan
descrizione: This threat actor targets defense contractors and diplomatic institutions for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: NotPetya
paesi_vittima: Argentina, Denmark, France, Russian Federation, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Threat actors deploy a tool, called NotPetya, with the purpose of encrypting data on victims’ machines and rendering it unusable. The malware was spread through tax software that companies and individuals require for filing taxes in Ukraine. Australia, Estonia, Denmark, Lithuania, Ukraine, the United Kingdom, and the United States issued statements attributing NotPetya to Russian state-sponsored actors. […]

titolo: Targeting of employees of companies that operate U.S. nuclear power plants
descrizione: A threat actor targeted employees of companies that operate nuclear power plants in the United States, which prompted the Department of Homeland Security and the FBI to issue an alert to the industry. An administrative network of the Wolf Creek Nuclear Operating Corporation was compromised.

titolo: WannaCry
paesi_vittima: China, France, Germany, Japan, Russian Federation, Spain, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: A threat actor used a tool called WannaCry to encrypt data in compromised networks, and intended to provide the victims with the decryption key only after a ransom had been paid. The threat actors used an exploit, called EternalBlue–first discovered by the U.S. National Security Agency–to propagate WannaCry in organizations using the Windows operating system. On December […]

titolo: Phishing campaign against Montenegro
descrizione: A threat actor targeted officials from Montenegro for the purpose of espionage. The phishing campaign came during the country’s accession to NATO.

titolo: Targeting of French presidential candidate Emmanuel Macron’s campaign
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the campaign of French presidential candidate Emmanuel Macron. The U.S. National Security Agency has confirmed that it believes Russia was responsible.

titolo: Compromise of a Danish Ministry of Defense e-mail service
descrizione: A threat actor compromised an email service maintained by the Danish Ministry of Defense, and is also believed to have compromised Ministry of Foreign Affairs networks.

titolo: Compromise of the International Association of Athletics Federations
descrizione: A threat actor compromises the networks of the International Association of Athletics Federations with the purpose of obtaining the medical records of athletes. In October 2018, the United States indicted seven alleged Russian military intelligence officials involved in the incident.

titolo: Targeting of Marco Rubio’s presidential campaign
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the presidential campaign of U.S. Senator Marco Rubio.

titolo: Compromise of email accounts of a UK TV station
descrizione: A threat actor compromised Islam Channel, a small UK TV station, in July 2015. In October 2018, the United Kingdom publicly attributed the compromise to Russian military intelligence.

titolo: Distributed denial of service against the government of Montenegro
descrizione: A threat actor launched a distributed denial of service attack against government of Montenegro websites.

titolo: Operation BugDrop
paesi_vittima: Austria, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Ukraine
descrizione: This threat actor targets critical infrastructure entities in the oil and gas sector, primarily in Ukraine. The threat actors deploy the BugDrop malware to remotely access the microphones in their targets’ computers to eavesdrop on conversations.

titolo: Compromise of the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs’ computer networks.

titolo: Attempted compromise of Norwegian government networks
descrizione: A threat actor targeted the computer networks of the Norwegian government: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the army, a nuclear radiation protection agency, and a parliamentary group.

titolo: Compromise of the Czech foreign minister’s computer
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the computer networks of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic, including those used by the foreign minister and close aides.

titolo: Compromise of a mobile app used by Ukrainian artillery units
descrizione: A threat actor compromised a mobile app that Ukrainian artillery units used to assist with targeting. The compromise of the app is believed to have allowed the threat actor to monitor the movements of Ukrainian units in order to facilitate military targeting by Russian-backed rebels in eastern Ukraine.

titolo: A compromise causes a power outage in Kiev, Ukraine
descrizione: A threat actor compromised computer networks that control an electricity substation in the north of the Ukrainian capital, Kiev, causing a power outage. To accomplish its task, the threat actor used a tool known as CrashOverride.

titolo: Yahoo breach (2016)
descrizione: A threat actor exploited a vulnerability in Yahoo’s account log-in process, allowing it to access user accounts without a password. Approximately thirty-two million accounts were affected.

titolo: Compromise of Ukrainian banks
descrizione: A threat actor compromised Ukrainian banks.

titolo: Warning of impending incident on Russian banking network
descrizione: Russian authorities warned that a foreign intelligence agency was seeking to compromise its banking sector.

titolo: Attempted compromise of U.S. think tanks
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise the networks of U.S. think tanks associated with international affairs and national security. The attempts occurred shortly after the U.S. election in 2016.

titolo: Compromise of gaming companies
paesi_vittima: China, Korea (Republic of), Russian Federation, Taiwan, United States
descrizione: A threat actor uses a tool called PassCV to target video game companies, stealing digital certificates to use in cyber operations against other targets.

titolo: Compromise of the World Anti-Doping Agency
descrizione: The World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) confirmed in September 2016 that it had been compromised by suspected Russian threat actors in a data leak of confidential information about forty-one athletes who competed in the Rio Olympic Games. The data revealed drug-test results and medical data pertaining to “therapeutic use exemptions,” situations in which WADA allows athletes […]

titolo: Project Sauron
paesi_vittima: Belgium, China, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Russian Federation, Rwanda, Sweden
descrizione: This threat actor compromises targets in the Military, telecommunications, and financial sectors in Belgium, China, Iran, Russia, Sweden, and elsewhere.

titolo: Spear-phishing campaign against Google accounts in 2015
descrizione: A threat actor conducted a spear-phishing campaign against more than 1,800 Google accounts, including those of military and government personnel, journalists, and nongovernmental organizations, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Compromise of the Democratic National Committee
descrizione: In June 2016, suspected Russian threat actors were discovered in the networks of the U.S. Democratic National Committee (DNC). Intruders gained access to its research on Republican presidential candidate Donald J. Trump and emails and correspondences among DNC officials. Over the course of the presidential campaign, the threat actors released DNC correspondence through intermediaries such […]

titolo: RUAG espionage
descrizione: A threat actor compromised a Swiss defense contractor.

titolo: Denial of service incident against media websites in Sweden
descrizione: A threat actor launched a denial of service attack on ten news websites in Sweden, triggering a local police investigation. U.S. diplomatic cables later revealed that the United States suspected that Russia was responsible for the incident.

titolo: Compromise of a power grid in eastern Ukraine
descrizione: In December 2015, a threat actor compromised power distribution companies in western Ukraine, causing a power outage for more than 230,000 residents. Several control centers were targeted by suspected Russian hackers, who were able to siphon operator credentials and gain access to the power grid for the Ivano-Frankivsk region. The power outage lasted as long […]

titolo: Attempted compromise of the Dutch organization investigating the crash of flight MH17
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise the networks of the Dutch Safety Board, the group charged with investigating the crash of Malaysia Airlines Flight 17, which crashed in Ukraine.

titolo: Compromise of an unclassified network associated with the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff
descrizione: A threat actor compromised an unclassified network used by the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff for espionage purposes.

titolo: Gamaredon
descrizione: A Russian-linked threat group known as Gamaredon uses custom-developed malware in attacks aimed at Ukraine. The group has been active since at least 2013. Also known as Invisimole.

titolo: Compromise of TV5 Monde
descrizione: In May 2015, threat actors compromised French television network TV5 Monde, disrupting broadcasts for three hours and gaining access to the network’s social media accounts. A group allegedly allied with the self-declared Islamic State and calling itself the Cyber Caliphate initially claimed responsibility for the incident. However, later investigations revealed links to Russian hacking group […]

titolo: Compromise of unclassified White House networks
descrizione: Threat actors compromised unclassified White House networks using access from compromised networks at the State Department.

titolo: Targeting of Ukrainian law enforcement and government officials
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise Ukrainian officials in government and law enforcement for espionage purposes. Ukrainian intelligence claims this was done in support of Russian-backed military activities in eastern Ukraine.

titolo: Equation Group
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Algeria, China, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Kenya, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Pakistan, Russian Federation, Syrian Arab Republic, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Yemen
descrizione: In 2015, Moscow-based Kaspersky Lab published a report on the Equation Group, a threat actor active since 2001 [PDF]. It was responsible for infecting approximately five hundred systems in at least forty-two countries. The malware used by Equation Group had the ability to reprogram hard drives and then self-destruct, which made the operations effectively invisible […]

titolo: Attempted compromise of Ukrainian email accounts
descrizione: A threat actor attempted to compromise email accounts in Ukraine for espionage purposes.

titolo: Regin
paesi_vittima: Afghanistan, Algeria, Belgium, Brazil, Fiji, Germany, India, Indonesia, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Kiribati, Malaysia, Pakistan, Russian Federation, Syrian Arab Republic
descrizione: A threat actor, using a tool dubbed Regin, compromised telecommunications networks and collected information about how those networks operate to facilitate espionage on other targets such as governments, financial institutions, and academics.

titolo: Compromise of the U.S. State Department
descrizione: A threat actor compromised the unclassified network of the State Department for espionage purposes.

titolo: DragonOK
descrizione: This threat actor targets high-tech and manufacturing companies, primarily from Japan, for the purpose of acquiring trade secrets. In 2017, cybersecurity firms released evidence pointing to the threat actor expanding its targets to Russian and Tibetan interests.

titolo: Machete
paesi_vittima: Argentina, Belgium, Brazil, China, Colombia, Cuba, Ecuador, France, Germany, Malaysia, Peru, Russian Federation, Spain, Sweden, United States, Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)
descrizione: This threat actor targets military, government entities, and telecommunications providers, primarily in Latin America, for the purpose of espionage.

titolo: Turla
paesi_vittima: Armenia, Austria, Belarus, France, Germany, India, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Iraq, Kazakhstan, Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Tajikistan, United States, Uzbekistan
descrizione: This threat actor targets governments, militaries, and research organizations for espionage purposes.

titolo: Crouching Yeti
paesi_vittima: China, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Poland, Russian Federation, Spain, Turkey, Ukraine, United Kingdom, United States
descrizione: Also known as Bromine. This threat actor targets companies in the education, energy, construction, information technology, and pharmaceutical sectors for the purposes of espionage. It uses malware tailored to target industrial control systems.

titolo: Compromise of the Finnish Ministry of Foreign Affairs
descrizione: A threat actor compromised Finland’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs for espionage purposes. The threat actor specifically targeted communications between Finland and the European Union.

titolo: Team Spy Crew
descrizione: This threat actor primarily compromises government entities and human rights activists in Eastern Europe and Central Asia for espionage purposes. It has also compromised private and public sector entities in the Middle East and in Western countries.

titolo: Flame
paesi_vittima: Austria, Egypt, France, Hungary, Iran (Islamic Republic of), Israel, Lebanon, Russian Federation, Saudi Arabia, Sudan, Syrian Arab Republic, United Arab Emirates
descrizione: A threat actor, using a tool called Flame, targeted computers in the Middle East region; the most compromises were in Iran. This compromise gained widespread coverage due to the modular nature of the malware the threat actors used.

titolo: Estonian denial of service incident
descrizione: In April 2007, Russia-based attackers launched a series of denial of service attacks against Estonian public and private sector organizations in response to the government’s removal of a Soviet war monument from downtown Tallinn. For three weeks, threat actors targeted state and commercial websites, ranging from foreign and defense ministries to banks and media outlets, […]
